description_detailed: Eleven months after landing on the beaches of Normandy, Allied forces scattered across Europe celebrate the surrender of Nazi Germany. A historic day, “V-E DAY” (or Victory in Europe Day) symbolizes the end of nearly six years of conflict and the return of peace for millions of Europeans. 80 years after this decisive victory, Monnaie de Paris celebrates this historic event by paying a new tribute to the great Allied nations who fought for the liberation of France and Europe.This commemorative coin is dedicated to peace and remembrance, symbolized by a flight of doves over the Arc de Triomphe and the flame of the Unknown Soldier. The flags of the 4 major Allied nations circle the monument in a V-shape, in celebration of the Allied victory over Nazi Germany. The cardlet presents a composition based on the 4 soldiers represented in the “From D-DAY to V-E Day” collection, each celebrating victory and the return of peace to Europe.
